information: These are blocks used for the transport and storage of mana.
The synthesizer consumes certain magical items to produce mana in its internal buffer.
The tank stores mana within for later use.
The "Manantenna" transports mana wirelessly from a target position to the block it is attached to.
Right-click on the manantenna with a wrench and a position card in your offhand to set the target source position.
